description: By Kathryn Depauw Jan 14, 2025TRAVERSE CITY — An affordable housing project for primary and secondary teachers and staff is one step closer to reality.The Traverse City Area Public Schools Board of Education voted unanimously Monday to create the interlocal agreement required to facilitate a housing project next to Blair Elementary.
